name: AIWorks

compute.name: HomePc AIWorks supervisor and dashboard
compute.notes: Runs from a detached checkout under .local/runtime. The dashboard listens on 127.0.0.1:4318 and is local only.

compute.name: Second owner PC (HOMELENOVO) supervisor
compute.notes: Older build. Runs its own campaigns; there is no shared view across PCs.

providers.name: GitHub (gh CLI)
providers.notes: Owner-authenticated CLI used for pull requests and issue comments.

providers.name: Agent CLIs (Claude, Codex, Cursor, AGY)
providers.notes: Executor chain for workers; Cursor's native sandbox is unavailable on Windows.

secrets.current: Owner's local gh and agent CLI logins on each PC; no secret values in this repository.
secrets.notes: Do not copy values into the registry.

notes: Operations dashboard is local only (127.0.0.1) and the platform has no UI review authority over it.

exceptions.summary: For an owner-registered campaign the supervisor creates worktrees, branches, PRs and issue comments in the target repo; never merges or deploys.
